title: When complaint to be issued.
bodyText: In the event any person fails to comply with a penal summons given to such person or attached to a vehicle, or if any person fails or refuses to deposit bail as required and within the time permitted, the court shall forthwith issue a warrant for the person's arrest.
bodyHtml: [§291C-169]  When complaint to be issued.  In the event any person fails to comply with a penal summons given to such person or attached to a vehicle, or if any person fails or refuses to deposit bail as required and within the time permitted, the court shall forthwith issue a warrant for the person's arrest. [L 1978, c 111, pt of §2; gen ch 1985]
